query: SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'intentId',id,'logicalIntentDigest',logical_intent_digest, 'sourceEventId',source_event_id, 'communicationClass',CASE WHEN communication_class='SYSTEM_TRANSACTIONAL' THEN 'PUBLIC_SERVICE_OR_TRANSACTIONAL' ELSE 'DISCRETIONARY_OR_RESTRICTED' END, 'purpose',CASE WHEN communication_class='SYSTEM_TRANSACTIONAL' THEN 'SYSTEM_TRANSACTIONAL' ELSE communication_class END, 'topicDigest',topic_scope_digest,'recipientSubjectId',recipient_subject_id, 'policyVersion',audience_policy_version) FROM ops.communication_intents WHERE id=$1
